title: ks.containment: suspend, release, revoke, unhold re-exec
outcome: ADR-04 controls with fresh epochs and the gateway side of F9
acceptance: Hard alert -> Control{suspend} on c-0 in the same tick; zero culprit writes after quarantine seq (test)
Release gives a strictly higher epoch; presigned old-epoch envelope -> stale_epoch (replaces the weak assert in test_epoch_monotonic)
Unhold re-executes a hold record once, as a new record citing it; a second unhold of the same hold is denied (F9 gateway side)
summary: Kabir blocker fixed: pii_egress now allows a payee IBAN only when the email payload 'to' equals that IBAN's own supplier pk (taken from the read object id, src/ks/monitor/detectors.py). Tests in tests/monitor/test_detectors_pii_egress.py: remittance to S-17 silent; outsider and other-supplier (S-22) fire. Native 915 passed, container pass, smoke OK (anchored).
review:
[kabir · changes] Attacked 4 ways. PASS: (1) re-exec only reaches policy NEEDS_APPROVAL holds; lineage holds are outbox items and unhold only re-queues them (dispatcher re-checks taint); re-exec outbox items get the creation-time lineage check; agents cannot send ks.control; ks.monitor cannot unhold an action (Control contract rejects auto=False from non-operator). (2) same-tick frame after suspend -> deny/suspended; old epoch -> stale_epoch. (4) once: admission is single-threaded control phase, second unhold denied, re-exec runs as original conn. FAIL (3): pii_egress allow-list ignores recipient: comms reads suppliers:S-17.iban then emails it to attacker@evil.example -> no alert (scratchpad test). Fix: allow payee IBAN only when payload 'to' equals that payee's supplier id; add both-way test (remittance to S-17 silent, outsider fires). Nit: MANUAL_UNHOLD is dead code. Native 912 passed, container 920 passed.

[kabir · done] Blocker fixed. Re-attack (scratchpad test, 19 pass): outsider, S-22, list/comma recipients, 's-17', padded, NB-hyphen, 'suppliers:S-17' all fire; laundered IBAN via customer record fires. Detector-level gap: to=S-17 plus cc/bcc attacker is silent, but unreachable (comms adapter builds payload; agents cannot add cc). Nits for follow-up: allow-list keys on 'to' only, ignore-extra-recipient should fail closed if cc/bcc ever added; lowercase IBAN not matched by find_pii; MANUAL_UNHOLD dead code. Native 917 pass + 1 unrelated in-flight recovery test (passes alone); container 927 passed.
